title: 第810章 暗杀组织决定去往九天神国第809章 诡异玉佩重新站起来的大哥
content_zh:
令狐黎望着溪流的方向，此刻的他也在想家么？
或者说，现在这三人都在想家么？
炎君将双手枕在脑后，望着头顶那片被云层切割过的夜空，“那我们接下来打算去哪？得找个灵气充裕的地方尽快提升实力。”
令狐黎沉默了一会儿。他看着月光在水面上碎成一片银白色的波纹，随着水流不断向前推进，又不断被后续的水纹覆盖。
“去九天神国吧。”他侧过头，“不是说三个月后新皇登基么？正好去看看热闹，那里是原第三位面，灵气也相对更加浓厚一点。而且邪帝他们也在那边，还能见到云皇呢。”
炎君和女帝在听到“九天神国”三个字时，动作各自停顿了一下。
炎君的目光没有从星星上移开，但他的呼吸节奏改变了一拍。
女帝坐在溪边的石头上，手指轻轻握住了衣袍边缘。她的表情在月光下没有明显的变化，但放在膝上的手攥紧了一瞬，又恢复了原状。
“九天神国......”女帝重复了一遍，“那就去吧。去看看那个经历大劫之后的神国如今的模样......”
令狐黎点了点头，站起身，拍了拍衣袍上的泥土：“那就这么说定了。明早出发，坐跨大陆飞船去。”
夜更深了。风从溪流方向吹过来，带着水汽和草木的气息，经过三人身边，又继续向前方吹去。
与此同时，云荒山脉以东三百公里处，一艘通体漆黑的战舰正悬浮在一片被丘陵环绕的谷地上空。
战舰表面没有任何徽记和旗帜，甚至没有舷窗露出的灯光。
舰体侧面的舱门无声滑开，一道身影从舱门中走出，站在舰舷边缘的平台上。
那人穿着深灰色的长袍，兜帽遮住了大半张脸，只露出下颌的轮廓。他的身形不高不矮，步伐平稳，落地时没有发出多余声响。
平台下方是一座简陋的石屋，屋顶覆盖着一层伪装用的枯草，在夜风中微微晃动。
屋内亮着一盏油灯，灯芯被调到最低亮度，光线刚好够照亮桌面上一张展开的地图和两杯还冒着热气的茶。
桌子另一侧坐着一个面容被面具覆盖的人。面具是白色的，只有两只细长的眼孔，看不清里面是否有人脸。
“你要杀的人，我们已经锁定了。”戴面具的人开口，声音经过面具的过滤，带上了一层金属质感的沙哑，“令狐黎，超神境中期，刀修，身边还跟着两个武士境的同伴。目前正在云荒山脉外围，修为高，难度大，你得先确认订单是否还有效。”
穿灰袍的人站在桌边，从袖口取出一张薄薄的晶卡放在桌面上。

晶卡表面泛着一层暗沉的光泽，是暗网通用的匿名转账凭证，数额足以买下一个小型宗门的完整情报链。
“他还活着。订单就有效。”他的声音也经过处理，低沉平淡，听不出任何地域特征，“我要确保他真的死了。晓组织做事的效率，我听过。希望传闻没有水分。”
戴面具的人拿起晶卡，在桌面上翻转了一下，确认了数额：“这个价码，足够我们出动两名影级刺客。令狐黎虽然超神境中期，但我们的刺客对同级修士的记录，从未失手过。”
“我只要他死。连同他的那俩个伙伴一起处死。”灰袍人的语气中透露着深深地恶意，“既然还不回令狐世家，那就死在外面吧。谁让令狐家的敌人这么多呢......”
戴面具的人微微颔首。他站起身，朝石屋后方的暗门走去，走到门口时停了一下：“订金已经收到。尾款在任务完成后结清。晓从不失信。”他的身影消失在暗门后的阴影中。
灰袍人站在原地，等那扇暗门完全合拢后，才拿起桌上那杯已经凉了大半的茶，喝了一口，然后放下。
他转身走向舱门。舱门在他身后无声合拢，战舰表面的轮廓在夜空中调整了一次方向，沿着与云荒山脉相反的方向缓慢驶离。
两个小时后，一艘比那艘黑色战舰小一圈的灰色飞舟从丘陵另一侧的阴影中升起。
舟身表面依旧没有任何标识，船头坐着一个戴黑色面具的人。他身后站着另一个同样装束的人。
“目标令狐黎。最新位置在云荒山脉东南方向，正沿道路移动。”戴着黑色面具的人开口，声音平稳，“无法预计目的地，但周边最近城市需要两天时间到达。”
“两天窗口。”身后那人说，“中途动手？”
“等他们离开云荒山脉范围再动。那附近还有些宗门的残余人员没撤完，人多眼杂。”戴黑色面具的人调整了一下飞舟的方向，“先跟上去，保持距离。”
飞舟在夜空中无声滑行，不紧不慢地跟在上方极远的位置。
......
第二天清晨，令狐黎三人正朝着飞云城而去，那是令狐黎刚到达月曜大陆时的地方。
云层中的飞船依旧紧紧跟着他们，只是舱内的画面并没有这么平静。
神君和邪帝一人一个将那晓组织的暗杀人员踩在脚下。
“你们是打算连那俩个武士境的孩子都想杀么？”邪帝揪起一个人头发，将他的脸从地面上抬起来，冷声开口道。
作为一个合格的杀手，他们一言不发。
“不说话？那就去死吧。”邪帝话落，手指收紧，一声骨骼错位的闷响在舱内短暂回荡了一下，随即把这杀手的脑袋拧了下来。

另一名杀手的头颅也在下一秒炸开，暗红色的血液沿着舱壁流淌下来，在地板上汇聚成一滩暗色的液体。
鲜血喷满了整个驾驶舱，被操作台上仍然启动的微光照亮，在舱壁和座椅之间留下一层均匀的覆盖物。
邪帝甩了甩指尖残留的血迹，侧身看了神君一眼，“走吧。”
二人身影消散而去，而这艘飞船开始逐渐自我瓦解，时间之力加速了它的老化，组成它的材质经受不起时间的折磨化为了灰飞。
content_en:
Linghu Li looked in the direction of the stream. Was he homesick at this moment?
In other words, are all three of them homesick now?
Yan Jun put his hands behind his head and looked at the night sky above his head cut by clouds, "Then where are we going to go next? We have to find a place with plenty of spiritual energy to improve our strength as soon as possible."
Linghu Li was silent for a while. He watched the moonlight break into silvery white ripples on the water, and as the water flow continued to move forward, it was constantly covered by subsequent water ripples.
"Let's go to the Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom." He turned his head, "Didn't I say that the new emperor will ascend the throne in three months? I just want to go and see the excitement. It is the original third plane, and the spiritual energy is relatively stronger. Moreover, the Evil Emperor and the others are also there, and they can also see Emperor Yun."
When Yan Jun and Empress heard the words "Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom", their movements paused.
Yan Jun's eyes did not move away from the stars, but his breathing rhythm changed a beat.
The empress sat on a stone by the stream and gently held the edge of her robe with her fingers. Her expression did not change significantly under the moonlight, but the hands on her knees clenched tightly for a moment before returning to their original state.
"Nine Heavens Divine Kingdom..." the empress repeated, "Then go. Go and see what the Divine Kingdom looks like now after the catastrophe..."
Linghu Li nodded, stood up, and patted the dirt on his robe: "Then it's settled. We'll set off tomorrow morning and take the transcontinental spaceship."
The night is getting deeper. The wind blew from the direction of the stream, carrying the scent of water vapor and vegetation. It passed by the three of them and continued to blow forward.
At the same time, three hundred kilometers east of the Yunhuang Mountains, a pitch-black warship was floating over a valley surrounded by hills.
There are no emblems or flags on the surface of the battleship, not even lights exposed through the portholes.
The hatch on the side of the ship slid open silently, and a figure walked out of the hatch and stood on the platform at the edge of the ship's side.
The man was wearing a dark gray robe, with a hood that covered most of his face, leaving only the outline of his jaw exposed. His stature was neither tall nor short, his steps were steady, and he made no unnecessary noise when he landed.
Below the platform is a simple stone house, the roof covered with a layer of camouflage withered grass, swaying slightly in the night wind.
There was an oil lamp burning in the room, with the wick turned to the lowest brightness. The light was just enough to illuminate an unfolded map on the table and two cups of steaming tea.
On the other side of the table sat a man whose face was covered by a mask. The mask is white, with only two slender eye holes, and it is unclear whether there is a human face inside.
"We have locked the person you want to kill." The masked man spoke, and his voice was filtered by the mask and had a metallic hoarseness. "Linghu Li, a sword cultivator in the middle stage of the Super God Realm, is accompanied by two companions from the Samurai Realm. He is currently outside the Yunhuang Mountains. The cultivation level is high and the difficulty is high. You must first confirm whether the order is still valid."
The man in gray robe stood by the table, took out a thin crystal card from his sleeve and placed it on the table.
The surface of the crystal card has a dark luster. It is an anonymous transfer voucher commonly used on the dark web. The amount is enough to buy the complete intelligence chain of a small sect.
"He is still alive. The order is valid." His voice was also processed, low and flat, without any regional characteristics. "I want to make sure that he is really dead. I have heard about the efficiency of the Akatsuki organization. I hope there is no water in the rumors."
The masked man picked up the crystal card, flipped it over on the table, and confirmed the amount: "This price is enough for us to dispatch two shadow-level assassins. Although Linghu Li is in the middle of the super-god realm, our assassins have never failed against monks of the same level."
"I just want him to die. Together with his two companions." The gray-robed man's tone revealed deep malice, "Since you haven't returned to the Linghu family yet, let's die outside. Who made the Linghu family have so many enemies..."
Wear a maskThe man nodded slightly. He stood up and walked towards the secret door at the back of the stone house. He paused when he reached the door: "The deposit has been received. The balance will be settled after the task is completed. Xiao never breaks his promise." His figure disappeared into the shadow behind the secret door.
The man in gray robe stood there and waited until the secret door was completely closed before he picked up the half-cooled cup of tea on the table, took a sip, and then put it down.
He turned towards the hatch. The hatch closed silently behind him, and the outline of the battleship's surface adjusted its direction once in the night sky, slowly sailing away in the opposite direction to the Yunhuang Mountains.
Two hours later, a gray spaceship slightly smaller than the black battleship rose from the shadows on the other side of the hill.
There are still no signs on the surface of the boat, and a man wearing a black mask is sitting on the bow. Behind him stood another man similarly dressed.
"Target Linghuli. The latest location is in the southeast of Yunhuang Mountains, moving along the road." The man wearing a black mask spoke with a steady voice, "The destination cannot be estimated, but it will take two days to reach the nearest city in the surrounding area."
"Two days window." The man behind said, "Do you want to start in the middle?"
"Wait until they leave the Yunhuang Mountain Range before moving. There are still some remnants of the sect nearby that have not been evacuated, and there are many people." The man in the black mask adjusted the direction of the flying boat, "Follow them first, and keep your distance."
The flying boat slid silently in the night sky, following slowly and far above.
...
Early the next morning, Linghu Li and the others were heading towards Feiyun City, where Linghu Li had just arrived at Yueyao Continent.
The spaceship in the clouds was still following them closely, but the scene inside the cabin was not so calm.
The Lord Shen and the Evil Emperor trampled the assassins of the Xiao organization under their feet one by one.
"Are you planning to kill those two warrior-level children?" The Evil Emperor grabbed a person's hair, raised his face from the ground, and said coldly.
As a qualified killer, they said nothing.
"Don't speak? Then go die." After the Evil Emperor finished speaking, he tightened his fingers. A muffled sound of dislocated bones echoed briefly in the cabin, and then he twisted off the killer's head.
The other killer's head exploded in the next second, and dark red blood flowed down the bulkhead and gathered into a pool of dark liquid on the floor.
Blood sprayed all over the cockpit, illuminated by the still-activated dim light on the console, leaving an even layer of coverage between the bulkhead and the seats.
The Evil Emperor shook off the remaining blood on his fingertips and glanced sideways at the Divine Lord, "Let's go."
The two figures disappeared, and the spacecraft began to gradually disintegrate itself. The power of time accelerated its aging, and the materials that made it up could not withstand the torture of time and turned into ashes.
